3. Delegation Compliance
Delegation Compliance = assign_l2_time − assign_l1_time, must be ≤ 48 Hrs (otherwise Breached). Exception: if breached but the case has an sr_edoc date (Service Request) or a resolution_sla_target_end_time (Incident Management), it is treated as doable by L1 and is NOT counted as breached.
Assignment Level Owner (L1 Engineer) — assign_l1_time L2 Engineer(s) — assign_l2_time Total Delegated Cases Within 48 Hrs Breached (>48 Hrs) Delegation Compliance %

4. Resolution Compliance
assign_to (Assignment Level) × assign_to_l1_engineer (Owner) — resolution_sla_breached (0 = Non-Violated, 1 = Violated)

Resolution Review

Comprehensive assessment of documentation quality — Resolution Code, Requirement/Problem Statement, and Resolution Steps — analysed team-wise. Global filters applied. Click any metric or table row to drill down and export.

Purpose & Objectives
📝 Documentation Quality
Enable teams to improve completeness of Requirement/Problem Statement and Resolution Steps fields for every closed case.
📚 SOP / KB Creation
Help customers leverage this data to create Self-Resolution Knowledge Bases and Standard Operating Procedures for future use.
🤖 AI-Ready Handling
Support the transition towards AI-driven case handling — currently managed manually. Quality data is the foundation for automation.
